title: introduce-dependency-staleness-sentinel-and-staged-lint-sharding
author: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: Our monorepo accumulates outdated dependency ranges that increase CI flakiness and slow down lint/test feedback. This PR implements a lightweight dependency-staleness sentinel (a small service + CI gate) to mark crates/npm packages that haven’t been updated for >9 months and surfaces a compact remediation plan. It also refactors lint/test CI into staged shards (fast-feedback lanes + extended lanes) so quick edits get sub-60s feedback while full checks run in parallel without blocking merges.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds tools/dep-sentinel/ (Go) and a small GitHub Action that runs weekly to produce a compact report and a dependency-provenance.json used by CI.
- Introduces a new CI lane (staged-lint) that shards linters by path heuristics and runs a fast subset (typechecks + critical ESLint rules + go vet) on PR hotpaths.
- Adds a pre-merge dependency gate that fails PRs when the sentinel flags a direct dependency with a critical security patch available or if a package is >18 months stale and used by a server path. The gate is configurable via .github/dep-gate-config.yaml.
- Moves heavy lint/format passes to nightly and to the extended CI lane to reduce pre-merge latency.
- Adds lightweight dashboards and telemetry hooks for dependency churn (console alerts/metrics).

Checklist: 
- [x] Implement dep-sentinel service and CI action
- [x] Integrate sentinel output into staged CI lane
- [x] Add path-aware lint sharding logic and tests
- [x] Add docs/ci/dep-sentinel.md and update CONTRIBUTING.md with quickfix steps
- [x] Run migration on main to backfill dependency-provenance.json

Backwards compatibility and safety: The dependency gate is opt-in per repo via .github/dep-gate-config.yaml. Default behavior is advisory (warn-only) for the first two weeks after rollout; this PR toggles warn->fail after a staged rollout and a cross-team sync. All changes are behind feature flags and infra configs so we can quickly revert to advisory mode.

Why this is different from previous dependence/CI work: Rather than a broad, heavyweight dependency prune, this approach gives observable, actionable signals (staleness + vuln presence + owner suggestion) and pairs those signals with a CI flow that reduces developer pain (fast lint on hotpath, full checks async). The dep-sentinel is intentionally small (single binary + periodic job) to minimize ongoing maintenance.

--- a/.github/workflows/staged-lint.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/staged-lint.yml
@@ -1,4 +1,12 @@
 name: Staged Lint
+on: [pull_request]
+jobs:
+  fast-feedback:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - name: Run fast lints
+        run: scripts/ci/fastpath-dispatch.sh --fast
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Nice small sentinel—can we keep the weekly job output under 64KB? If the report grows too big it breaks action artifacts. Please add trimming logic.
Asha Menon: Good catch — added a truncate+summary routine and pagination for full reports in tools/dep-sentinel/main.go (commit a1f4e2c).
Mira Patel: The pre-merge gate looked scary at first; can we default to warn for the first rollout? Add an override flag for emergency opt-out.
Asha Menon: Configured default to advisory mode and added .github/dep-gate-config.yaml -> fail_after_days to allow staged enforcement.
Samir Gupta: CI runtime improved locally. Two nits: (1) add unit tests for sharder heuristics edge cases, (2) document how to opt-out for infra-only repos.
Asha Menon: Added tests/test-sharder-heuristics.py and docs/ci/dep-sentinel.md with opt-out instruction.
ci_checks: unit-tests: pass (go tests + python sharder tests)
release_notes: Adds a weekly dependency-staleness sentinel, a configurable pre-merge dependency gate, and staged lint sharding to speed up PR feedback. Default gate behavior is advisory for staged rollout. See docs/ci/dep-sentinel.md for operational details.
notes_for_ops: Rollout plan: week 0 (warn-only), week 2 (fail for server-touching deps older than 18 months), monitor dep_sentinel.stale_count and dep_gate.reject_rate dashboards. To revert to advisory quickly toggle .github/dep-gate-config.yaml -> mode: advisory and re-deploy the action.
post_merge_actions: Backfilled dependency-provenance.json on main and triggered a one-time run of dep-sentinel weekly job. Opened follow-up tasks: ENG-4201 (auto-PRs for critical deps), ENG-4202 (nightly full-lint to S3 archival).
